11.t: Working with data: mould and temperature
q: How much of the bread was covered by mould at 20 degrees C?
Describe how mould cover changes from 4 to 25 degrees C.
Use the data to explain why food is kept in a fridge (about 4 degrees C).
At 4 degrees C mould covered only 2% in 7 days compared with 70% at 25 degrees C: cold slows the growth of fungi, so food lasts longer.
Mould cover falls above 30 degrees C. Suggest a reason, and one way to make the results more reliable.

Very warm conditions may dry out the bread or be too hot for this mould to grow well. More reliable: more samples per temperature, more temperatures between 25 and 40 degrees C, and the same amount of water for each sample.
